talk.text: Wait. Is that really a school?
It is! It's the architecture school at the University of São Paulo, designed by Vilanova Artigas in nineteen sixty-nine.
Okay, but how do you get between floors?
Ramps! The whole school is joined by ramps, and it's open to the city.
Is anyone actually allowed in there?
Yes, it's open to the city, and students gather right in the middle.
Why is everything left as bare concrete?
Exposed concrete. No paint, no cladding, just the structure itself.
